props.label: Problem
props.html:
The problem

Most small-business websites are slow, fragile, and bolted together

You shouldn't need a dozen paid plugins and a developer on call just to have a website that works.

Plugin & subscription creep

WordPress and Shopify need paid add-ons for the basics — forms, SEO, security, speed. Every one is another monthly bill and another thing that breaks.

Slow & fragile

Database-driven sites are slow and get hacked. Google quietly marks slow sites down — and slow sites lose customers.

Maintenance burden

Constant plugin and core updates, security patches and backups. It never ends, and one bad update can take the site down.

Leads slip through

Contact forms silently fail and enquiries get lost. The whole point of the website — and it never reaches your inbox.

Nifty removes all of it — the essentials are built into the platform, the site is pre-built and edge-served, and enquiries are wired to your inbox automatically.

props.label: How
props.html:

You (and AI) create and edit everything in the Nifty dashboard — every page sliced into editable blocks you can change in a live visual editor.

Publish as static

Your site is compiled into fast, secure, ready-to-serve static pages. Nothing to assemble on each visit, no live database to slow it down or attack.

Served from the edge

Delivered from Cloudflare’s global network — hundreds of cities, close to every visitor — for near-instant loads and better Google rankings.

For the technical

Enough to satisfy the curious.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
FAQ

Questions, answered

Everything you’re probably wondering before you join the waitlist.

Do I need to know how to code?
No — AI builds the site and you edit it visually. Click any element to change it; there’s no code to touch unless you want to.
Where is my site hosted?
On Cloudflare’s global edge network — served from hundreds of locations worldwide, so it’s fast and secure everywhere.
Is hosting included?
Yes. Hosting, SSL, spam protection, SEO and lead email are all included in the subscription — no separate bills.
Can I use my own domain?
Yes — connect any domain and we handle the SSL and the redirects for you, with no duplicate-content SEO problem.
What about WordPress or Shopify?
They’re great for huge or complex e-commerce. For a fast, secure, lead-generating business site, Nifty is simpler, faster and cheaper to run.
Can agencies rebrand it?
Yes — full white-label of the whole dashboard, plus multi-site management, team roles and controlled client logins.
When does it launch and what’s the price?
Launching soon. Pricing is announced at launch — join the waitlist now for founding-member pricing and first access.

props.label: Problem
props.html:
The problem

Most small-business websites are slow, fragile, and bolted together

You shouldn't need a dozen paid plugins and a developer on call just to have a website that works.

Plugin & subscription creep

WordPress and Shopify need paid add-ons for the basics — forms, SEO, security, speed. Every one is another monthly bill and another thing that breaks.

Slow & fragile

Database-driven sites are slow and get hacked. Google quietly marks slow sites down — and slow sites lose customers.

Maintenance burden

Constant plugin and core updates, security patches and backups. It never ends, and one bad update can take the site down.

Leads slip through

Contact forms silently fail and enquiries get lost. The whole point of the website — and it never reaches your inbox.

Nifty removes all of it — the essentials are built into the platform, the site is pre-built and edge-served, and enquiries are wired to your inbox automatically.

The complexity lives behind the scenes. You just describe, tweak, and go live.

You (and AI) create and edit everything in the Nifty dashboard — every page sliced into editable blocks you can change in a live visual editor.

Publish as static

Your site is compiled into fast, secure, ready-to-serve static pages. Nothing to assemble on each visit, no live database to slow it down or attack.

Served from the edge

Delivered from Cloudflare’s global network — hundreds of cities, close to every visitor — for near-instant loads and better Google rankings.

You bring the business. Nifty brings the build. You stay in control the whole way.

props.label: Technology
props.html:
The technology

Enterprise-grade infrastructure, done for you

The same kind of global network that protects and accelerates some of the biggest names on the internet — delivered as a simple, done-for-you service.

The simple version

1

Build & manage

You and AI create and edit everything in the Nifty dashboard.

2

Publish as static

The site is compiled into fast, secure, ready-to-serve pages.

3

Served from the edge

Delivered from Cloudflare’s global network, close to every visitor.

For the technical

Enough to satisfy the curious.

  • Architecture. Statically-generated pages — no live database on the public site.
  • Hosting / CDN. Cloudflare Pages — a global edge network across hundreds of cities.
  • Security. Free SSL/HTTPS and DDoS protection — no database or plugins to exploit.
  • Spam protection. Cloudflare Turnstile — privacy-friendly and invisible.
  • Form email. SMTP2GO transactional delivery — a dedicated sending account per site, bundled in.
  • Edge logic. A lightweight edge worker handles the dashboard proxy, preview redirect and lead routing.
"Enterprise-grade infrastructure — the same global network that protects and accelerates some of the biggest names on the internet — delivered as a done-for-you service."
